subject.title: fix(mattermost): preserve websocket posts across restarts

question: Should Mattermost adopt this durable-ingress failure policy, including deliberately terminating the WebSocket when persistent SQLite admission failures would otherwise silently drop posts?
rationale: This is a protected maintainer-labeled PR that changes a channel’s delivery and availability behavior; test coverage alone does not establish the intended operator-facing failure mode.

options.title: Review with live restart proof
options.body: Confirm the append-failure policy and require a redacted real Mattermost receive → restart → single recovery-dispatch trace before merge.

options.title: Preserve the current socket failure behavior
options.body: Keep the connection alive after persistent admission failure only if maintainers define a safe alternative that cannot silently discard later posts.

options.title: Pause for a narrower adapter proposal
options.body: Pause this branch if the Mattermost-specific failure and reconnect semantics need a separate design decision before the shared drain is adopted.

recommendation.title: Review with live restart proof
recommendation.body: Confirm the append-failure policy and require a redacted real Mattermost receive → restart → single recovery-dispatch trace before merge.
